synced.label: Synced
synced.meaning: Receipt uploaded; this does not confirm a member credit.

queued.label: Queued
queued.meaning: Awaiting upload; not a confirmed member credit.

duplicate.label: Duplicate
duplicate.meaning: Repeated receipt observation; no additional credit is implied.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.meaning: Receipt rejected; review the source without retrying a financial action.

unknown.label: Status unavailable
unknown.meaning: Receipt delivery status is unavailable; no member credit is implied.

money.policy: Fit display numerals down to a 16sp-equivalent floor that still respects user text scaling. Never abbreviate, ellipsize or split digits. If even that cannot fit, preserve the complete numeral in a local scroll region with an explicit hint.

security.memberActivation: Admin role AND members.enroll; revalidate inside the command transaction.
security.drafts: Only ephemeral non-secret drafts. No credentials in saved state, web storage or logs.
security.unknownFinancialState: Never show success or an allocation action.
